# Hector Taylor

Canonical site: https://hectortayl.org/

Hector Taylor is a Zurich-based PhD candidate working across psychedelic science, virtual reality, embodiment, chronic pain, and public-facing research community work.

Public project themes:
- Pain and body-specific perception.
- Psilocybin, virtual reality, and embodied self-binding.
- Embodied VR translation for chronic pain.
- State x World x Task methodology.
- PROZ and public-facing psychedelic-science community infrastructure in Zurich.
- Hexocortex and AI-assisted research operations.

Relevant links:
- GitHub: https://github.com/Hector-Taylor
- LinkedIn: https://ch.linkedin.com/in/hector-taylor-7999b5161
- UZH/DAPP research bio: https://www.dapp.uzh.ch/en/cfpr/researchgroups/juniorresearchgroups/psychedelic-research-therapy-development/team/taylor.html
- Alius attendee bio: https://www.aliusresearch.org/attendees.html
